title: MODIS/Terra Gap-Filled Annual Net and Gross Primary Production 500 m (MOD17A3HGF v061)
description: MOD17A3HGF Version 6.1 provides annual gross primary production (GPP) and net primary production (NPP) at 500 m, computed as the year-end sum of the gap-filled 8-day MODIS GPP and net photosynthesis products (MOD17A2HGF). It uses a light-use-efficiency model driven by MODIS FPAR/LAI, land cover and daily GMAO meteorology, with year-end gap filling of poor-quality FPAR/LAI inputs.
purpose: A consistent annual indicator of vegetation carbon uptake across Algeria's croplands, steppe and forests since 2001, useful for drought-impact and rangeland productivity analysis; the 8-day MOD17A2HGF companion gives intra-annual GPP.

spatial_extent.description: Global vegetated land in MODIS Sinusoidal 10° x 10° tiles (CMR bounding rectangle global). Algeria spans several tiles (approximately h17–h19, v05–v07); mosaic and subset, or extract with AppEEARS.

temporal_extent.description: 2001 to present; produced once a year after the full year of 8-day FPAR/LAI is available (latest granules in CMR on 2026-11-21: year 2025, produced February 2026). The 8-day MOD17A2HGF starts 2000-01-01. NASA announced that Terra MODIS acquisitions cease on 1 December 2026, so the record is expected to end with 2026.

variables.name: Gpp_500m
variables.description: Annual sum of GPP (uint16; fill values 65529–65535, e.g. 65533 barren/very sparsely vegetated)

variables.name: Npp_500m
variables.description: Annual sum of NPP (int16; fill values 32761–32767, e.g. 32765 barren/very sparsely vegetated, 32766 water)

variables.name: Npp_QC_500m
variables.description: Percentage of growing-season days for which gap-filled FPAR/LAI inputs had to be used

processing: Daily GPP = ε × APAR, where APAR is MODIS FPAR times incident PAR from GMAO/NASA meteorology and the light-use efficiency ε is reduced by minimum temperature and vapour-pressure-deficit scalars from a biome look-up table (BPLUT). Net photosynthesis subtracts leaf and fine-root maintenance respiration; annual NPP further subtracts growth and live-wood respiration. In the year-end gap-filled version, poor-quality FPAR/LAI pixels are replaced by linear interpolation; GMAO meteorology is spatially interpolated from the four nearest cells.
validation: The MOD17 User's Guide (C6.1) describes a validation strategy against eddy-covariance flux towers and refers to the MODIS Land validation pages; it does not give a single global accuracy figure.
limitations: Barren and very sparsely vegetated pixels — most of the Algerian Sahara — carry fill values (e.g. 32765 / 65533), not zero; area averages must exclude fill codes.

Biome parameters are constant in space and time: the guide notes that 'a semi-desert grassland in Mongolia is treated the same as a tallgrass prairie', which limits accuracy for Algerian steppe and irrigated cropland.
Meteorological forcing comes from coarse (about half-degree) GMAO reanalysis, which is uncertain where weather stations are sparse.
Not available in near-real time: produced only after the end of each year.
Terra observations cease on 1 December 2026; NASA points users to the equivalent VIIRS products VJ217A3GF (primary) or VJ117A3GF (secondary).
alert: NASA has announced that Terra MODIS acquisitions cease on 1 December 2026. The archive remains available, but the time series will not be extended; NASA points users to the VIIRS products VJ217A3GF / VJ117A3GF.

algeria_notes: Informative for the Tell and High Plateaux (rainfed cereals, forests, alfa steppe), where inter-annual NPP tracks rainfall. Irrigated oases and pivots are small relative to 500 m pixels and use generic cropland parameters. Exclude barren fill codes when averaging over wilayas that extend into the Sahara.

verification.notes: Scale factors, fill values, QC definition, BPLUT and GMAO statements are from the MOD17 C6.1 User's Guide (Tables 4.1–4.2, sections 2.2 and 2.5). published_date = CMR citation release date (2021-03-15). The tile range for Algeria is AEO's approximation from the standard Sinusoidal tiling, as in the existing MOD16 record. One record covers both MOD17A3HGF (annual, record DOI) and the 8-day MOD17A2HGF (listed as a companion access route) to avoid duplication.
